grammar_title: 限制性定语从句:关系副词 when / where / why(及与关系代词的判断)
source: 人教版2019必修一 Unit 5 Discovering Useful Structures:限制性定语从句(关系副词 when/where/why,= 介词+which)。句子地道、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项)。

points.overview: 先行词表时间(day/time/year/moment 等)、从句不缺主语或宾语(只缺时间状语)时,用关系副词 when(= 介词+which)。
先行词表地点(place/country/city/room 等)、从句只缺地点状语时,用关系副词 where(= 介词+which)。

points.point: why(原因)+ 关系副词 vs 关系代词判断
points.overview: 先行词为 reason、从句缺原因状语时用 why;但若从句缺主语/宾语,即使先行词表时间/地点也要用关系代词 that/which;介词后只能用 which。

questions.stem: "I still remember the day ____ I first wrote a Chinese character."
questions.explanation: 先行词 day 表时间,从句不缺主宾(只缺时间状语)→ when。

questions.stem: "There was a time ____ people in China were divided by dialects."
questions.explanation: 先行词 time、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: "Spring is the season ____ many students start learning a new language."
questions.explanation: 先行词 season 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "1949 was the year ____ the country began a new chapter."
questions.explanation: 先行词 year 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "I will never forget the moment ____ I could finally think in German."
questions.explanation: 先行词 moment 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "That was the day ____ Emperor Qinshihuang unified the writing system."
questions.explanation: 先行词 day、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: "There comes a point ____ a foreign language no longer feels foreign."
questions.explanation: point 在此表'时刻'→ when。

questions.stem: "Sunday is the day ____ I usually practise my calligraphy."
questions.explanation: 先行词 day → when。

questions.stem: "He still recalls the night ____ he gave his first speech in English."
questions.explanation: 先行词 night 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "There is an age ____ children begin to learn characters."
questions.explanation: age 在此表'时期'→ when。

questions.stem: "That was the period ____ many varieties of characters appeared."
questions.explanation: 先行词 period 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "I remember the week ____ I first started the German course."
questions.explanation: 先行词 week 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "Autumn is the time of year ____ we hold the language festival."
questions.explanation: 先行词 time of year → when。

questions.stem: "It was an era ____ writing was done on bones and shells."
questions.explanation: 先行词 era 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "I'll never forget the first day ____ Mrs Haus introduced herself to us."
questions.explanation: 先行词 day、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: "There was a time ____ I really wanted to give up learning."
questions.explanation: 先行词 time → when。

questions.stem: "I remember the morning ____ I read my first book in Latin."
questions.explanation: 先行词 morning 表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "That was the moment ____ the whole room suddenly fell silent."
questions.explanation: 先行词 moment → when。

questions.stem: "202 BCE was the year ____ the Han Dynasty began."
questions.explanation: 先行词 year → when。

questions.stem: "I'll always remember the day ____ I finally understood my mum's words."
questions.explanation: 先行词 day、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: "Qinshihuang built a unified country ____ the writing system developed in one direction."
questions.explanation: 先行词 country 表地点、从句完整 → where。

questions.stem: "I had finally come to a place ____ I could think in this foreign language."
questions.explanation: 先行词 place 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "This is the school ____ I first learned to write Chinese."
questions.explanation: 先行词 school 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "Canada is a country ____ several languages are spoken."
questions.explanation: 先行词 country 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "That is the classroom ____ Mrs Haus taught us German."
questions.explanation: 先行词 classroom → where。

questions.stem: "I once wished to live in a country ____ German was spoken every day."
questions.explanation: 先行词 country 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "China is a place ____ people of different dialects communicate in writing."
questions.explanation: 先行词 place → where。

questions.stem: "We visited the museum ____ ancient bones and shells are kept."
questions.explanation: 先行词 museum 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "It was a small room ____ we met for our language classes."
questions.explanation: 先行词 room 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "There are still villages ____ an old dialect is spoken today."
questions.explanation: 先行词 villages 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "The library is the place ____ I quietly studied Latin every afternoon."
questions.explanation: 先行词 place → where。

questions.stem: "That is the building ____ the summer German course was held."
questions.explanation: 先行词 building 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "Reading opened a window to a world ____ I could see meanings, not just words."
questions.explanation: 先行词 world 表抽象地点 → where。

questions.stem: "It was a time and a land ____ people were divided geographically."
questions.explanation: 先行词 land 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "I found a quiet corner ____ I could read in peace."
questions.explanation: 先行词 corner 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "That is the office ____ our German teacher used to work."
questions.explanation: 先行词 office 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "Rome was a city ____ Latin was once the main language."
questions.explanation: 先行词 city 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "This is the studio ____ Chinese calligraphy is taught."
questions.explanation: 先行词 studio 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "He showed me the hall ____ the old dictionary was first written."
questions.explanation: 先行词 hall 表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "There is a website ____ students can practise foreign languages for free."
questions.explanation: website 视作抽象地点 → where。

questions.stem: "The reason ____ he gave up was simply a lack of practice."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、从句缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: "There are many reasons ____ people learn a foreign language."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reasons → why。

questions.stem: "I finally understood the reason ____ my mum had encouraged me."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "One reason ____ this has been possible is the writing system."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "That is the reason ____ Mrs Haus's students loved German so much."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "This is the main reason ____ written Chinese has survived so long."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "I don't know the reason ____ he suddenly stopped studying Latin."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "There must be a reason ____ so many students choose Chinese."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "The day ____ changed my view of language was truly special."
questions.explanation: 先行词 day 虽表时间,但从句缺主语 → 用关系代词 that(不是 when)。

questions.stem: "The book ____ I read that summer opened a whole new world."
questions.explanation: 先行词 book、从句缺宾语 → 关系代词 that。

questions.stem: "The language ____ she loved most of all was German."
questions.explanation: 先行词 language、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: "The place ____ I visited last week was a calligraphy museum."
questions.explanation: 先行词 place 虽表地点,但从句缺宾语(visited ___)→ 用 that(不是 where)。

questions.stem: "The words ____ felt strange at first soon began to make sense."
questions.explanation: 先行词 words、从句缺主语 → that。

questions.stem: "The first character ____ I learned to write was 马 (horse)."
questions.explanation: 先行词 character、从句缺宾语 → that。

questions.stem: "The goal ____ I had been fighting for was finally within reach."
questions.explanation: 先行词 goal、从句缺宾语 → that。

questions.stem: "The dialect ____ they speak at home is hard for outsiders to follow."
questions.explanation: 先行词 dialect、从句缺宾语 → that。

questions.stem: "These were animal bones and shells on ____ symbols were carved."
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后只能用 which(不可 that)。

questions.stem: "That was the way in ____ the writing system developed."
questions.explanation: the way in which;介词 in 后用 which。

questions.stem: "Calligraphy is a means by ____ China's present connects with its past."
questions.explanation: a means by which;介词 by 后用 which。

questions.stem: "The brush with ____ calligraphy is done must be held correctly."
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指物用 which。
